column1: # OpenProcessor embedding model catalog: the encoder versions a project can back a space with.
# One file, one reader (src/services/embedding_spaces/catalog.py), the shape of examples/vlm/catalog.tsv.
# Tab-separated; the first non-comment line names the columns. A row is immutable once synced:
# a changed input_spec, weights or dimension is a NEW version row, never an edit.
# modalities and matryoshka_dims are comma lists; input_spec is an EncoderInputSpec JSON object.
# weights_sha256: the SHA-256 of the checkpoint file (PE: export/download_pe_weights.py pin;
# MobileCLIP2: the Hub LFS object id of open_clip_pytorch_model.bin at the pinned commit).
